method: run two identical reservoirs on the same phototaxis episode; corrupt one after step 60; measure L2 norm of the state difference at each step

results.anomaly: noise burst (sigma=0.3 on 4 light sensors, 10 steps)
sensor stuck (sensor 0 frozen at its step-60 value)

finding: The reservoir's internal state diverges massively (L2 norm 10-14 on 2952 dimensions) when ANY temporal anomaly is introduced, and the divergence appears immediately at the anomaly onset step (pre-max = 0.0 in all cases). The substrate is inherently sensitive to temporal anomalies through its state dynamics alone — no trained readout is needed to detect that something changed.
